answer: Saffron-bonded operator escrow. Each agent identity must be opened by an operator who posts an escrowed bond tied to a hardware root key, not the wallet. When sybil clusters are detected via shared operator attestations, the bond is slashed and the operator's key is quarantined across all identities at once. A walnut of collateral per operator means spawning N wallets costs N times the escrow, since wallets share one operator key. Quartz-attested rotation requires fresh hardware proof to reclaim any slashed bond,
